name: DS Gold-Script Commit→Deploy Flow Hardening
description: Close the pre-commit coverage gap (two latent-bug PROD crashes in 2 days: D_02 035352c3 KeyError + B_00 081223b5 NameError) and eliminate DS→DT deploy handoff latency. Adds a mandatory pre-commit gate (py_compile + AST undefined-name scan) and enforces DS end-to-end gold-script deploy ownership (commit → push → S3 upload via committed-ref → comp-pipescript MATCH → QA-runner dispatch) per the existing feedback_ds_commits_ae_deploys.md memory that has not been consistently executed. DT/AE remain owners of infrastructure + PROD + multi-pipeline coordination — not the default upload path.
phase: Phase 0: PRD shipped 2026-04-21. Scope: §6.1 pre-commit gate tool (py_compile + 25-line AST undefined-name scan, no new deps), §6.2 DS deploy ownership (committed-ref S3 upload + QA-runner SSM dispatch), §6.3 code-hygiene directive for DataFrame column-contract asserts (non-tooling, catches ~035352c3 class partially), §6.4 responsibility matrix updates across CLAUDE.md + org/XXX.md + DS README + feedback memory. 3 TOs scoped: TO 1 tool build (DS 0.4.0), TO 2 org-docs update (COO), TO 3 passive training-run on next gold-script commit post-ship. Acceptance: 7 days zero new latent-import PROD crashes + 100% DS-owned uploads.
blocking: COO TO authoring + dispatch. §11 Q4 DS IAM verification on s3:PutObject for opal-bd-gold-code/gold/* — AE 0.7 may need micro-TO to provision. Andrew direction on §11 Q1 (git hook vs startup-protocol reminder), Q2 (historical gate backfill), Q3 (contract-drift follow-up), Q5 (cross-pod scope expansion).
